scope: run control engineering checks; run_live itself is stubbed
checks: discovery reads status from summary.json (completed, stopped, failed), marks a run with no summary and no process as interrupted, and reads the day from the last complete call without loading the world
a live run_live process is found by its --out directory; stop sends SIGINT and sees it exit

start checks the model server first, launches run_live in its own session with the chosen pace, adds modules to a copied policy, records pid.json beside the run, and refuses a directory that already holds a run
resume starts a fresh sibling (NAME-r2) from the checkpoint and its archived policy; changes made while stopped are applied to a staged copy and logged, and the old checkpoint is never edited
